# 🚀 Deployment checklist

- Release:
- Commit:
- Environment:
- Operator:
- Date/time:

## Before deployment
- [ ] Pull request approved
- [ ] npm ci completed
- [ ] npm run lint completed
- [ ] npm run build completed
- [ ] Preview reviewed
- [ ] Environment and host settings reviewed
- [ ] SPA fallback configured
- [ ] No secrets committed
- [ ] Content and media approved

## After deployment
- [ ] Root route loads
- [ ] /cakes loads and refreshes
- [ ] /about loads and refreshes
- [ ] /blog loads and refreshes
- [ ] Images and fonts load
- [ ] No critical console errors
- [ ] Mobile and desktop checked
- [ ] Deployed commit recorded
